overview: Srinagar's Dal Lake houseboats and Mughal gardens, Gulmarg's gondola to snow, and Pahalgam's river valleys and meadows.
fit: Wonderful for both kids: shikaras, snow, horses and meadows. Check the security situation before booking.
season: April–June is spring and early summer (10–25°C), with snow still at Gulmarg's top phase. September–October has autumn colours. December–February is snowy and very cold.

gettingThere.detail: Srinagar to Gulmarg 1.5 hr; to Pahalgam 2.5 hr

gettingAround: Hire a local cab; Gulmarg and Pahalgam have union-fixed local taxis and ponies.

todo.title: Gulmarg Gondola
todo.why: Phase 1 to Kongdoori; phase 2 for snow
todo.book: Book online on the JKCCC site; sells out

foodTips: Vegetarian options exist (Krishna Dhaba in Srinagar is famous).
save: Fix all-in cab rates before the trip
Shoulder months (Sept, early April) are cheaper
safety: Check the latest government travel advisory before booking and again before flying
Pony handlers: agree price, use helmets
health: Cold at Gulmarg even in summer; layers
kids: Snow at Gulmarg is the 4-year-old's highlight
Rent snow boots and coats at Tangmarg

days.plan: Fly to Srinagar; shikara at sunset; houseboat night
Mughal gardens; old city; drive to Gulmarg
Aru or Baisaran; back to Srinagar; fly home
